mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_payload ( payload_id, payload_type, storage_type, content, content_path, content_sha256, preview, compressed, encrypted, created_at ) VALUES ( #{payloadId}, #{payloadType}, #{storageType}, #{content}, #{contentPath}, #{contentSha256}, #{preview}, #{compressed}, #{encrypted}, #{createdAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload_type = VALUES(payload_type), storage_type = VALUES(storage_type), content = VALUES(content), content_path = VALUES(content_path), content_sha256 = VALUES(content_sha256), preview = VALUES(preview), compressed = VALUES(compressed), encrypted = VALUES(encrypted), created_at = VALUES(created_at)
mapper.select: SELECT id, payload_id, payload_type, storage_type, content, content_path, content_sha256, preview, compressed, encrypted, created_at FROM agent_payload WHERE payload_id = #{payloadId}
